title: holdout_unseal.v1
description: One holdout unseal audit record (alpha-engine-config-I10502), written at `holdout/unseal/{trading_day}/{ruling}.json`. Unsealing is a RESERVED matter (principles.md 3.2): `crucible holdout --unseal` refuses without a ruling reference, and this record is what makes the authorised read reconstructable afterwards from durable artifacts alone. `holdout_digest` ties the record to the exact bytes that were released, so a holdout edited after an unseal is visible as such.

trading_day.description: NYSE trading day the unseal is keyed to (4.12).

ruling.description: The human ruling that authorised this unseal, in the fleet reference format. Required by the schema AND refused before this document is built: an unseal with no named ruling is the thing the mechanism exists to prevent, not a field to leave blank.

reason.description: Why, in the operator's own words. The ruling says it was allowed; this says what it was for.

holdout_digest.description: The `seal.digest` of the document that was unsealed. A later reading whose live digest differs from every unseal record's is a holdout that moved after it was released.

unsealed_at_utc.description: Wall-clock UTC instant of the unseal, ISO-8601. Provenance, never a key (4.12).
